meta.title: Forge CLI — Crucible
meta.description: Forge syncs skills, rules, and workflows across coding harnesses. Install v0.7.0 with npm, Homebrew, or Scoop.

hero.headline: One source. Five coding harnesses.
hero.subheadline: Forge v0.7.0 distributes shared skills, rules, and workflows from Git or local sources. It writes native paths and formats for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, and Cline. Preview changes, detect drift, and sync on demand or on a schedule.

setup.heading: Configure once. Sync when you need it.

global.title: Global setup
global.description: Run forge init --global and choose a shared resource source. The wizard detects supported coding harnesses and writes the machine-level config. Enable the scheduler if you want automatic syncs.

project.title: Project setup
project.description: Run forge init inside a repository to add project-specific sources and targets. Commit .crucible/forge.config.yaml so the team uses the same source configuration.

setup.footer: Use forge sync --dry-run to inspect the plan before any file changes.

source.heading: Start with Forge Skills Starter
source.description: Forge works with any Git repository or local source. {link} adds conventions for developing and testing skills, rules, and workflows before you distribute them.
source.note: Use the starter as a source, or point Forge at the repository you already have.

architecture.heading: Shipped sync architecture. Planned extension boundaries.
architecture.description: Forge v0.7.0 separates pure domain logic, command handlers, and I/O adapters. Its transactional sync pipeline resolves every source before protected writes. Native plugin delivery and the compiler remain roadmap milestones.
architecture.diagramAlt: Forge v0.7.0 architecture — domain, application, and infrastructure layers above the transactional sync pipeline, with separate v0.8 plugin-delivery and v0.9 compiler boundaries

items.title: Initialize and schedule
items.description: Detect coding harnesses, add a Git source, and configure OS-level auto-sync from the interactive wizard.

items.title: Update without drift
items.description: Check status, add another source, and sync updated resources. Forge reports drift between source, state, and target files.

items.title: Control the output
items.description: Use subdirectories, include and exclude filters, conflict strategies, dry-run previews, and the health dashboard.

commands.heading: Commands for the full sync workflow

items.desc: Detects coding harnesses, configures sources, and writes config.
Fetches sources, resolves targets, and writes files for each harness.
Shows drift between the last sync and current filesystem state.
Reports sync frequency, drift, source reachability, and active harnesses.
Opens the section-based interactive config editor.
Lists configured sources and synced file counts.
Removes a source with optional cleanup of synced files.
Edits a source with its current values pre-filled.
Installs, removes, and checks OS-level auto-sync scheduling.
Shows local telemetry status, configuration, and collected events.
Removes Forge configuration, scheduling, and tracked synced files.

assistants.heading: Five coding harnesses. One source.
assistants.footer: Each harness definition owns its paths and transforms. Command handlers stay unchanged.

items.title: Multi-source
items.description: Fetches every configured source before protected writes. Any acquisition failure aborts the sync.

items.title: Conflict resolution
items.description: Choose first-wins, last-wins, or error for source conflicts and explicit strategies for local edits.

items.title: Backup
items.description: Creates .bak copies before overwriting tracked files.

items.title: SHA-256 detection
items.description: Skips writes when the target content has not changed.

items.title: Dry-run
items.description: Previews acquisitions, transforms, and target changes without writing files.

items.title: Rollback
items.description: Compensates completed writes after a mutation failure and reports incomplete recovery explicitly.

items.title: Scheduler
items.description: Runs auto-sync through launchd, crontab, or Windows Task Scheduler.

items.title: Health dashboard
items.description: Reports sync frequency, drift, source reachability, and active coding harnesses.

canonical.title: Canonical
canonical.description: Files organized as skills/, rules/, and workflows/. Forge distributes and transforms them for each coding harness.

preStructured.title: Pre-structured
preStructured.description: Harness-specific directories such as .claude/ and .cursor/, copied without transforms.

hybrid.title: Hybrid
hybrid.description: Canonical resources transformed for each harness alongside pre-structured files copied directly.

compiler.heading: Roadmap: plugins in v0.8. Compiler in v0.9.
compiler.description: Forge v0.7.0 is the current release. The next milestones add native plugin delivery and then a compiler for coding-harness context. These capabilities are planned, not shipped.
compiler.diagramAlt: Forge roadmap — v0.8 native plugin delivery to Droid and Claude Code, v0.8.x plugin management and verification, and the planned v0.9 compiler boundary

items.title: v0.8 · Plugin packages
items.description: Package skills, commands, agents, hooks, MCP servers, rules, and output styles with Agent Plugins 1.0.

items.title: v0.8 · Droid and Claude Code
items.description: Deliver packages through both harnesses' native plugin systems first. Other harnesses follow in later waves.

items.title: v0.8 · Locked installs
items.description: Use local or pinned Git sources. Record resolved commits, content hashes, per-harness output hashes, and variants in a lockfile.

items.title: v0.8.x · Plugin workflow
items.description: Add plugin add, remove, update, and list commands, drift reporting, marketplace catalogs, and harness load checks.

items.title: v0.9 · Compiler
items.description: Compile and guard context for Droid and Claude Code after plugin delivery. Spec 0005 approves the v0.9 design; these capabilities remain planned, not shipped.

cta.heading: Install Forge v0.7.0
cta.description: Available through npm, Homebrew, and Scoop. Run forge init, choose a source, and preview your first sync.
